## Scenes

### 004.01 Market Day

The party reached the market. Someone said Jimjar's brother kept a stall here, and Mantol haggled over the price of rope, while a Spider-silk merchant watched.

#### The party shops in the market.

- Mantol sells the party rope.

### 004.02 The Long Way Round

The party took the long way back. Sarith was spoken of in whispers, and nobody could say where the drow had gone.

#### The party avoids the patrol.

- The party reroutes.
